description: List Six Flags parks (the combined Six Flags / Cedar Fair chain, including Carowinds, Cedar Point, Canada’s Wonderland, Magic Mountain, and the Hurricane Harbor water parks). Optionally filter by a name substring. Returns each park’s id, name, and owning destination, and flags your configured home park.
